review_notes: Segment 0: Several phrases were left largely as in the raw transcript where canonical reading was uncertain (e.g., 'कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन', 'लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः', 'अहो बत महत् पापं'). Please review these Sanskrit compounds for canonical accuracy if needed.

Segment 0: I corrected only high-confidence ASR errors and clear sandhi/splitting issues. If a strict edition of the Gītā text is required, compare the cleaned text against that edition before final publication.

Segment 1: Preserved several Sanskrit/phrase forms as in raw (no change) where certainty was low: 'कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्', 'अशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः', 'धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युः', 'तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्', 'शोकसंविग्नमानसः', 'ते उपस्थिताः', 'रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्', and 'घनतोपि'. Please review these for exact classical/Sanskrit orthography and intended sandhi (if human correction is desired).
Segment 1: I made only minimal, high-confidence corrections (spacing and an obvious ASR word error). No substantive doctrinal or content changes were made.
Segment 2: The word 'कामान' was left as in the raw transcript; ASR may have misrecognized this term but the intended word is not sufficiently clear from context—please review.

Segment 2: Sanskrit phrases such as 'कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं', 'वयं धृतराष्ट्रान् हन्तुं न अर्हाः', 'मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्' were retained; they appear coherent but should be checked by a human reviewer familiar with the source if exact canonical wording is required.

Segment 3: Please review medium-confidence changes for faithfulness to speaker intent: insertion of 'का' in the opening sentence (change 1), addition of 'था' (change 3), rephrasing 'सोल्जर एक सैनिक का धर्म निभाता है' (change 5), punctuation around the description of भीष्म and apposition (change 7), and correction of 'खाली कराओ' to 'खाली कराया गया' (change 8). These were grammatical/idiomatic fixes made with moderate confidence but may benefit from human verification against the speaker's original wording.

Segment 3: Unclear fragment 'कहीं स्कूल के आते में पड़े हुए हैं लोग महीनों' was left as in original because the intended wording was uncertain; please verify and correct if speaker meant a different phrase (e.g., 'कहीं स्कूल के आने में पड़े हुए' or 'कहीं स्कूल के कमरे में पड़े हुए').

Segment 7: Phrases that appear to be Sanskrit or heavily garbled (e.g., 'हरिओम तत्सत', 'मर्यादा माने मर्यै ही आद्रियते', 'जो मरणधर्मा मनुष्य है') were left as in the raw text because their intended wording is unclear; please review these for possible Sanskrit corrections.
Segment 7: Speaker's use of code-switching (English phrases) was preserved as spoken.

Segment 8: The phrase 'जय जीव' and the Ramayana example (mention of सुमंत्र जी and दशरथ) were noisy in the ASR. I preserved the quoted phrase 'जय जीव' as in the raw text but removed an apparent misrecognized pronoun ('तुम्हारा') and adjusted punctuation; please review the original audio to confirm the intended names/wording and whether 'जय जीव' is the correct greeting intended by the speaker.

Segment 8: I standardized the Sanskrit phrase 'अधर्मोऽभिभवति' and related forms where ASR introduced variants; please verify against the speaker's exact pronunciation if a precise Sanskrit citation is required.

Segment 9: संदर्भित संस्कृत/पारंपरिक उद्धरण-सीक्वेंस 'अधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत, अधर्मः अभिभवति।' अस्पष्ट है और सम्भवतः ट्रांसक्रिप्शन में त्रुटि है। अनसुलझा होने पर मौलिक अर्थ बदलने से बचते हुए कच्चा रूप रखा गया — कृपया मानव-समीक्षा करें।

Segment 9: पंक्ति 'दंड जतिन कर, भेद जहँ नर्तक नृत्य समाज।' स्पष्ट रूप से संस्कृत/Hindi छंद-सूत्र जैसा है पर कई शब्द असमंजसजनक हैं; अर्थात्मक परिवर्तन की सम्भावना के कारण मूल रूप बरकरार रखा गया — मानव-समीक्षा पर ध्यान दें।

Segment 10: Numerical population phrases appear inconsistent/unclear ("करीब सौ करोड़ से ज़्यादा, करीब एक सौ पाँच से दस करोड़ लोग रहते हैं", "एक करोड़ दस लाख लोगों में सात हज़ार थाने?"). These may contain ASR errors affecting factual numbers and should be checked against the original audio or speaker notes.
Segment 10: The code-switched phrase 'कोर्स स्मूथली' is preserved as spoken. If intended as an English phrase ('course smoothly'), confirm with the speaker recording before normalizing.

Segment 11: I corrected an early Sanskrit/phrase fragment ('अधर्मः अभिभवति उत' -> 'अधर्मो अभिभवात्') and the preceding ASR segment ('ये छह होता है' -> 'यह छूट जाता है'); these are medium-confidence corrections and should be reviewed by a human familiar with the speaker's intended Sanskrit phrasing to ensure doctrinal accuracy.
Segment 11: The proper name 'राजवर्धन' was left as in the raw text; if this was an ASR error (a different name intended), please verify.

Segment 12: Preserved several uncertain/ambiguous Sanskrit terms as in the raw transcript (e.g., "अवद्याः", "वार्ष्णेय", "स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय"). These terms were unclear in the ASR output and have not been altered to avoid changing doctrinal meaning—please verify against the original audio or a subject-matter reviewer if required.
Segment 12: Speaker uses code-switching (English words like 'प्रोटेक्शन', 'कंट्रीब्यूशन', and 'our scriptures'). These have been preserved or corrected conservatively.
Segment 14: Phrase 'चाऊँ-चाऊँ करने वाले चैनल' preserved as in raw; unclear if ASR distorted colloquial expression.
Segment 14: Phrase 'बेचहीं धर्म, बेचहीं वेद, धर्म दुहि लेहीं।' is likely garbled/dialectal; preserved verbatim for human review because correction could change meaning.

changes.original: तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान् स्वबान्धवान्।
changes.corrected: तस्मात् नाहं वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान् स्वजनान्।
changes.reason: Corrected multiple clear ASR/Speech-to-text errors to match the expected Sanskrit phrasing of the Gītā verse (तस्मात् नाहं वयं ... स्वजनान्).

changes.original: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।
changes.corrected: यद्यपि एते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः।
changes.reason: Inserted space to reflect the correct split 'यद्यपि एते' as in the verse; fixes ASR concatenation.

changes.original: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।
changes.corrected: कथं न ज्ञेयेत् अस्माभिः पापात् अस्मान् निवर्तितुम्।
changes.reason: Restored expected sandhi/splitting and word forms to match the intended verse reading (पापात् अस्मान् निवर्तितुम्).

changes.original: अधर्मो अभिभवत्युत। अधर्माभिभवात् कृष्ण।
changes.corrected: अधर्मोऽभिभवति। अधर्माभिभवात् कृष्ण।
changes.reason: Adjusted elision (अधर्मोऽभिभवति) and punctuation to reflect the Sanskrit vocative address 'कृष्ण' and more natural verse phrasing; fixes ASR segmentation.

changes.original: एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः संख्ये।
changes.corrected: एवमुक्त्वा अर्जुनः संख्ये।
changes.reason: Inserted space between 'एवमुक्त्वा' और 'अर्जुनः' to reflect separation of words (spacing error in ASR).

changes.original: विसृज्य सशरं चापम्।
changes.corrected: विसृज्य शरं चापम्।
changes.reason: Removed an extra 'स' before 'शरं' — likely ASR duplication; intended phrase 'विसृज्य शरं चापम्' (having cast away the bow/arrow).

changes.original: जिने
changes.corrected: जीने
changes.reason: Corrected ASR error: 'जिने' -> 'जीने' (Hindi infinitive 'जीने' = 'to live').

changes.original: हमको साँफ लगता है कि इस युद्ध से हम लोग केवल पाप के भागीदार होंगे।

changes.reason: ASR misrecognized 'हमें साफ' as 'हमको साँफ'; corrected to standard Hindi phrasing without changing meaning.

changes.original: यद्यप्येते, एते कौरवाः, एते धृतराष्ट्राः।
changes.corrected: यद्यपि एते, एते कौरवाः, एते धृतराष्ट्राः।
changes.reason: Fixed run-together transcription 'यद्यप्येते' to the intended 'यद्यपि एते' (separated words) matching surrounding usage.

changes.original: तो उस कुल से जो कुलक्षय से जो दोष उत्पन्न होगा, वो ऐसा भयंकर दोष होगा,
changes.corrected: तो उस कुलक्षय से जो दोष उत्पन्न होगा, वो ऐसा भयंकर दोष होगा,
changes.reason: Removed an obvious duplicated fragment 'जो कुलसे जो कुलक्षय से' to restore intended phrasing 'उस कुलक्षय से जो दोष'.

changes.original: वहाँ तो सबके सब युध्दसभा, वहाँ तो योद्धा, कामान सब लड़ने के लिए आए थे,

changes.original: तो उनको पाकिस्तान बाद में बुलाया गया भी, दस-पंद्रह साल पहले की बात है।

changes.corrected: और मेरे ख्याल से शोभना शर्मा जी की जब ये हो रही थी — आखिरी रजत जयंती या शायद कुछ सेलिब्रेशन था, तो उसमें उनको वहाँ भी बुलाया गया था, और उन लोगों को भी यहाँ बुलाया गया था।
